We read every public page - the pricing notes, the restriction lists, the support claims and the disclosures - and scored the platform on ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The verdict below is our own.
whatItClaims: AI and algorithmic market analysis producing signals and suggested entries.
Automatic or manual execution, with a browser-based platform.
No platform fees - broker spreads and overnight charges still apply.
Payouts reportedly within a day.
10 crypto assets through broker partners.
whatWeChecked: The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Provide your details on the signup page and confirm the account through the link you receive.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Fund the account with US$250 - bank cards, transfer, PayPal and Skrill are accepted.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your risk settings, choose automatic or manual mode, and keep the demo running while you learn.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
redFlags: Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.
A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.
Performance language with no dates attached.

faqs.a: The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: Is Global Finance safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

bottomLine: Global Finance is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
4.7 is our number, and it means the product works with conditions attached. The demo costs nothing; use it while the claims remain unproven.
